title: About
text:
I’m a Data Engineer and Master’s student in Data Science at Willamette University with over five years of experience designing scalable data platforms and cloud-native data pipelines. My passion lies in turning raw data into reliable, high-quality datasets that power analytics, machine learning, and business decision-making.
Throughout my career, I’ve worked across AWS and Azure ecosystems, building ETL pipelines, data warehouses, streaming applications, and modern Lakehouse architectures using technologies such as Apache Spark, Databricks, Snowflake, Airflow, and dbt. I enjoy solving complex engineering problems, optimizing large-scale data pipelines, and building systems that are reliable, maintainable, and production-ready. :contentReferenceoaicite:1
At Willamette University, my focus is on data engineering, machine learning, and cloud computing. My capstone explores forecasting U.S. unemployment using macroeconomic indicators through predictive modeling and feature engineering, combining data engineering with machine learning to generate actionable insights.



🚀 Passionate about building scalable cloud data platforms and continuously learning emerging technologies.
📚 Currently expanding my knowledge of distributed systems, MLOps, and advanced data engineering architectures while sharpening my problem-solving skills.
🎯 My goal is to become a Senior Data Engineer or Data Platform Engineer, building modern data infrastructure that enables organizations to make data-driven decisions at scale.




I’m always happy to connect about data engineering, cloud technologies, machine learning, open-source projects, or new career opportunities.

✉️ manishhk2808@gmail.com
